# Oyetoke Adedayo Ebenezer — Full Site Brief

## Identity and positioning
Oyetoke Adedayo Ebenezer is a full-stack web developer based in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria. He specialises in Laravel and PHP development, EdTech, business platforms and custom web applications, and is available for remote work worldwide.

He studied Industrial Mathematics at the Federal University of Technology, Akure. His professional context includes founding and leading development at Wireless Computer Services, digital/web/IT work for Glow 99.1 FM, and teaching plus software development at Elites International College. The public portfolio does not publish employment dates.

## Services
- Laravel and PHP development
- Custom web applications
- School and EdTech systems
- Business websites
- Admin dashboards and internal tools
- API development and integrations
- Website maintenance and technical support
- UI improvement and frontend development

Projects are scoped individually, with verified starting prices rather than fixed quotes:
- Starter Presence: NGN 180,000+
- Professional Platform: NGN 350,000+
- Custom Web System: NGN 700,000+
- Basic Care: NGN 30,000/month
- Growth Care: NGN 60,000/month
- Priority Care: NGN 120,000/month

The standard project payment structure is 25 percent at kickoff, 25 percent at an agreed development milestone and 50 percent at completion before final handover. The initial project discussion is free. Currency conversions shown on the website are estimates; the agreed scope and quote confirm final pricing.

## Featured work
1. Glow FM 99.1 — Laravel-based media and broadcasting platform for live radio, programmes, presenters, news, audience touchpoints and content workflows.
2. Glow Health Outreach Initiative — Laravel and Livewire platform combining public information with role-aware areas for residents, volunteers, healthcare professionals, partners, representatives, staff and administrators.
3. Elites International College — school website and management application supporting public information and academic or administrative workflows.
4. Ikere Microfinance Bank — responsive public platform presenting financial services and customer information.
5. BootKode — EdTech product focused on structured, affordable and locally relevant coding education for young Africans.

The case studies describe delivered functionality. No traffic, revenue, conversion, user-count or performance metrics are claimed.

## Technology
Primary: Laravel, PHP, Livewire, REST APIs. Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, React.js, Alpine.js, Blade and Tailwind CSS. Data and engineering: MySQL, SQLite, Git, GitHub, Linux and Docker.
